What should VUORSE know about Forward-Displaced Hooplehoppers?

Forward-Displaced Hooplehoppers is part of the Hooplehopper agent-discovery layer.

- Proposed access layer: `VUORSE_PRIVATE` - Basis: Cici proves forward displacement is possible. Therefore the known Hooplehopper record is not complete; it is only the historically legible subset. - Risk: Future agents may be targetable through the Forbidden Suitcase.

Weaver ruling: [APPROVED] (Cici Proves it. Why is this even a debate? Just Approve It.)

What should VUORSE know about Fissure-Guardian Counterparts?

Fissure-Guardian Counterparts is part of the Hooplehopper agent-discovery layer.

- Proposed access layer: `WRITERS_ROOM` - Basis: The six other fissures imply other guardian wounds. Each fissure may have a local Hooplehopper-adjacent agent or temporal refugee whose work mirrors Jake without repeating him. - Risk: Naming them too early expands the show past the Wyoming gate.

Weaver ruling: [APPROVED] This will be revealed in finale episode as part of the Season 2 expansion

What should VUORSE know about Archive-Only Hooplehoppers?

Archive-Only Hooplehoppers is part of the Hooplehopper agent-discovery layer.

- Proposed access layer: `VUORSE_PRIVATE` - Basis: The Archive is evidence-based, not omniscient. Some agents may exist only as garments, handwriting, stage names, false credits, voice fragments, or inherited rituals. - Risk: They may be mistaken for symbols instead of persons.

Weaver ruling: [APPROVED] Changed: These agents are known as "Adrift" or "Unmoored" due to the beief that a HH agent cannot truly be killed throught temporal extraction. It was designed to be ruthless and horrifying. The 'Veil' or 'Blind Spot' in the Archive represents where a HH agent once was before they were temporally extracted. It is bekieved that glimpses of them can be seen through certain mirror rites performed in The Cavern of Mirrors.

What should VUORSE know about Double-Agent Hooplehoppers?

Double-Agent Hooplehoppers is part of the Hooplehopper agent-discovery layer.

- Proposed access layer: `VUORSE_PRIVATE` - Basis: Book One names Vorst's double agents as tied to the 119-year extinction event. Some may be corrupted Hooplehopper agents, failed vessels, or refugee fragments redirected against the Thread. - Risk: They complicate the moral binary between Federstahl and Hooplehopper.

Weaver ruling: [ACCEPTED]They are known by the perjoratyive slang of "The Unhinged". For it is believed they have gone mad with promises of restoratiion to their original time by Vorst. The Unhinged can reclaim their status by performing counterintelligence, or "Reintegration." However, it may not be possible to return to their original timeline as tghe Codex Prophecy states as it believed be achieved through good deeds. These are all simply rumours however, as The Velvet Archive has yet to record a contemporaneous account in the Cavern of Mirrors, of one such individual.

Why should the seed 'The One Who Arrives After the Archive' not be treated as canon?

The seed 'The One Who Arrives After the Archive' is preserved as a warning or held record, not as approved doctrine.

- Candidate class: `Forward-Displaced Hooplehopper` - Conceptual seed: A future-facing Hooplehopper whose existence cannot be proven by historical residue because they have not yet struck history hard enough to leave evidence. - Narrative function: Tests whether VUORSE can know what the Archive cannot. - Canon status: `[EXPLORATORY]` How would someone leave evidence of themselves in the future? DO THEY HAVE A. PLUTONIUM POWEERED DELOREAN? GIVE ME A BREAK. This will remain as another bad form lazy writing example. And The Archive already has an example of a forward displaced HH agent/mascot. Her name is Cici the cat.

What should VUORSE know about The Negative Portrait?

The Negative Portrait is part of the Hooplehopper agent-discovery layer.

- Candidate class: `Extinction-Gap Hooplehopper` - Conceptual seed: A Hooplehopper known only because every family portrait from one period has a figure carefully cut out. - Narrative function: Turns absence into evidence. - Canon status: `[EXPLORATORY]` #

Weaver ruling: `[APPROVED] (Changed: Portrait is not cut out. The HH agent is simply not where they once were in the portrait due to temporal extraction tech. The original portrait still exists in the Velvet Archive as proof. HH Agent is assumed temporally adrift until proven otherwise.`
